description: This file contains unit tests for the 'repositories' package related to project differential data. It tests methods such as inserting diff rows, retrieving the most recent outer key, and fetching the most recent differentials, utilizing a PostgreSQL database connection and the testify assertion library.

classes.name: e.MappedDiffTarget
classes.description: Struct defining the diff target with upstream and downstream targets.

classes.name: e.AnalyzedDiffRow
classes.description: Structure representing a differential analysis result.

classes.name: e.DiffRow
classes.description: Basic diff row structure with metadata about changes.

methods.description: Clears the 'project_differential' table in the database.

methods.description: Returns the current count of rows in 'project_differential'.
